paragraphs: Rav Adda, son of Rav Yitzchak, Yoma 17a; Zevachim 38a, 111a; Niddah 54a: bar Yitzchak. Some say Rav Shmuel bar Yitzchak—perhaps they were brothers. Some say Rav Shmuel bar Abba, Beitzah 19b; the same subject, Pesachim 13b: Rav Adda bar Ahavah.
